repository_summary: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a Java 17 open-source library for processing XLSX workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel. It supports workbook/worksheet creation, cell manipulation, formatting, charts, shapes, tables, and more. The library is available on Maven Central under org.aspose:aspose-cells-foss:26.7.0 and is MIT-licensed. The README currently contains maintainer-authored content that should be preserved, but the installation section has an outdated version (1.0.0) and the Quick Start example does not match the verified minimal example from the repository.
